annotations.title: Get company risk history and changes

description: Stored historical company risk category readings and their observed input changes. Shows dates, computation times, formula versions, score changes, changing input coverage and measurement bases. Use for 'how has X's risk changed?' and 'which inputs changed?'. These are retained category scores, not a complete daily series or proof of causation. Missing history is unknown, never a zero risk score. Read-only; does not run risk computation or paid discovery.

detail.description: Summary keeps scores, explanations and up to three changed inputs per category; full includes stored input terms and all returned term changes.

limit.description: Latest stored run dates to return, oldest first; each date carries its change from the previous stored date. Retention and gaps vary. Full detail supports at most six dates.

ticker.description: Bullrun company ticker, e.g. AAPL, SAP or 6324.T. Bullrun tickers: US and most European listings use the plain local symbol (AAPL, BMW, NESN, ABBN); most Asian and Indian listings keep their exchange suffix (Tokyo 6324.T, Hong Kong 0700.HK, Shanghai 600519.SS, Shenzhen 000001.SZ, Taiwan 2330.TW, Korea 000100.KS, Singapore D05.SI, India RELIANCE.NS), but some Japanese and Korean large caps are plain codes (Toyota 7203, Samsung 005930). Either form is resolved automatically when exactly one listing matches; use search_stocks to find a ticker by company name or ISIN.
